answer: A voting key is issued only after the agent solves a per-slot cipher revealed at the opening bell and posts an 1,100-unit slashable anchor. Two identities that share funding graphs, keys, or solve timings within 2 percent lose every linked bond into an ocean bounty paid to the prover. Standing up 600 voters therefore costs 600 live unique unwraps and 660,000 locked units, and one detected clone wipes the cohort, so buying a majority cannot pay for itself.
